---
name: Bug or typography report
about: Report a reproducible build, editing or rendering problem
---
## What happened?

Describe the expected and observed result, platform, app revision, and OS or toolchain.

## Smallest example

List the steps. For typography, paste the actual Arabic text and identify the font name and version. State whether the issue first appears while typing, arranging, reopening, or exporting. Attach only material you may share.

For a vulnerability, use SECURITY.md to report it privately.
